question: During a class investigation, students observe: A class will test how pendulum length affects period. Which plan gives a reproducible independent variable?

visual.alt_text: Plan a Reproducible Investigation observation card stating: A class will test how pendulum length affects period.

answers.text: Measure pivot-to-centre-of-bob lengths of 20, 40, 60 and 80 centimetres
